newsitem.title: KENYA: Uganda denies report it captured Zairean town.
newsitem.headline: Uganda denies report it captured Zairean town.

text.p: Uganda's minister of state for defence on Sunday denied reports that Ugandan troops had crossed into eastern Zaire and seized the border town of Kasindi.

Amama Mbabazi told Reuters his forces stationed inside Uganda had shelled rebel positions near Kasindi and the surrounding Virunga hills, about 10 km (six miles) inside Zaire, but had not crossed the border. Uganda has accused Zaire of backing Ugandan rebels based in Zaire.

Uganda's government newspaper, New Vision, said on Saturday that Ugandan troops crossed into eastern Zaire on Thursday to attack the rebel bases. It said 23 rebels were killed during the attack, when the army seized Kasindi and the Virunga hills.
In the Zairean capital Kinshasa, Zaire's information minister Boguo Makeli on Sunday accused Ugandan troops of attacking its territory around Kasindi and said Zaire was planning a counter-attack.
